after.tpp_requirement_evidence: KEGG REST link/yli/K00946 and link/sce/K00946 (thiL, thiamine-monophosphate kinase, EC 2.7.4.16) return no genes; link/yli/K00949 (thiamine pyrophosphokinase) returns yli:2911892 = YALI2_E01340g, the old locus tag of W29 YALI1E25443g in GCF_001761485.1 (read 2026-10-22). blastp of all 27 Swiss-Prot ThiL entries (release 2026_03) against the W29 proteome finds no hit at E of at most 1e-5 (best E = 0.006 over 27% of the query); the THI80 control P35202 finds YALI1E25443g at E = 1.8e-24 (model/reports/tpp_requirement_20261022/thil_blast_w29.csv).
after.tpp_requirement_evidence_tier: verified on 2026-10-22: no KEGG K00946 assignment in yli (the CLIB122 genome) or sce, and no ThiL BLAST hit in W29. The THI80 control is a different protein family; it shows that the database and search work, not that a divergent ThiL would be found. Absence of a sequence homologue does not prove that no enzyme phosphorylates TMP. The yeast route, TMP to thiamine to TPP through THI80, is established/uncited.
after.tpp_requirement_rationale: R1342 is gene-less and, once TPP is required, was the only route to TPP that bypasses THI80 (R752). It is closed, not deleted, so its equation and cross-references stay for review.

after.tpp_requirement_evidence: yeast-GEM 9.1.1 cofactor pseudoreaction r_4598 consumes s_1475, named TDP (thiamine diphosphate: KEGG C00068, BiGG thmpp, C12H16N4O7P2S), at 1.2e-6 mmol/gDW; https://github.com/SysBioChalmers/yeast-GEM/blob/main/model/yeast-GEM.yml (raw file SHA-256 2ddfaaa73ead41ab243127d1b34fa56db2c86052f6eabcd12bb4eea93947dc17, read 2026-10-22)
after.tpp_requirement_evidence_tier: coefficient verified in yeast-GEM 9.1.1 on 2026-10-22; it is an S. cerevisiae value, not measured in Y. lipolytica, and is provisional. That TPP is a required cofactor (pyruvate dehydrogenase, 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase, transketolase, pyruvate decarboxylase) is established/uncited. m975 has no formula or cross-reference; its identity as thiamine diphosphate is inferred from its reactions R752 (KEGG R00619), R753 (KEGG R00616) and R933 (thiamine diphosphate transport).
after.tpp_requirement_rationale: No reaction drained cytosolic TPP (m975) to a sink: its consumers R753 (to thiamine triphosphate, m976) and R933 (into mitochondria, m1116) end in dead ends. So TPP synthesis and THI80 (R752) carried no flux and a THI80 knockout had no effect. Diluting TPP into new biomass makes its synthesis required, as yeast-GEM does for TDP.
